title: Container Health
description: Health and resource use of all containers on minerva, and of the host.

panels.title: Stopped
panels.description: Includes containers that exited on purpose, such as one-time jobs.

panels.title: Unhealthy
panels.description: Containers whose Docker healthcheck fails now.

panels.title: Started, 24h
panels.description: Containers that started in the last 24 hours. This includes deploys and crashes.

panels.title: OOM killed
panels.description: Containers whose last exit was an out-of-memory kill.

panels.title: Host memory
panels.description: On ZFS this can read high, because the ARC cache uses free memory. See the Host row.

panels.title: All containers
panels.description: Sorted so that unhealthy containers are first. Restarts counts Docker restart policy restarts of this container only. A deploy resets it.

panels.title: Health over time
panels.description: Only containers that define a Docker healthcheck.

panels.title: Container resources (top 8 in the time range)
Network received
panels.description: Containers that share a sidecar network report under the sidecar. Roon on macvlan may not appear.

panels.title: Network sent
panels.description: Containers that share a sidecar network report under the sidecar. Roon on macvlan may not appear.

panels.title: Container starts
panels.description: Each bar is a start of the container, from a deploy, a crash or a restart.

panels.title: Pressure: time spent waiting
panels.description: The share of time that at least one task waited for the resource. Check this first when applications are slow.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: The ZFS ARC gives memory back under pressure, but slowly.

panels.title: Disk busy (top 8)
panels.description: The share of time that each disk had IO in progress.

panels.title: Error log lines
panels.description: Lines that contain error, fatal, panic or exception. Some applications log these words at normal times.
